name: Applications
description: Create, build, deploy and inspect applications. Lifecycle requests answer 202 with an operation; poll AppState until it is done.

name: Environment
description: Environment variables of an application. Changing them redeploys a running application.

name: Configurations
description: Configurations hold key/value data that applications mount.

name: ConfigurationBindings
description: Bind configurations to applications and unbind them.

name: Services
description: Service instances created from the catalog, and their bindings to applications.

name: CatalogServices
description: The catalog of services that can be instantiated.

name: AppCharts
description: Helm charts used to deploy applications.

name: BuilderImages
description: Builder images used to build applications.

name: GitConfigs
description: Credentials and settings for cloning private git repositories.

name: GitProxy
description: Proxy to the GitHub and GitLab APIs.

name: ExportRegistries
description: Registries that application images and charts can be exported to.

name: Namespaces
description: Namespaces that hold applications, configurations and services.
